summary: Pure SSE cubic-spline (Hermite-basis) interpolation. Evaluates four cubic weight polynomials at the float parameter a8 by a vector polynomial t*P3 + P0 + t^2*P2 + t^3*P1 whose coefficient vectors are the XMM constants xmmword_5D8A80/60/70/50, broadcasts the resulting weights, blends the two control-pair inputs a5 (start) and a7 (end), and stores the two resulting single-precision values to a3, which is returned.

operations.description: Take the float parameter a8 as XMM v8 and square it into a1 lane 0 (t^2).
Compute a8 * t^2 into a2 lane 0 (t^3).
Broadcast t across all four lanes (shuffle 0), multiply by xmmword_5D8A80 (t coefficient vector) and add xmmword_5D8A60 (constant vector).
Accumulate the t^2 term (shuffled a1 multiplied by xmmword_5D8A70) and the t^3 term (shuffled a2 multiplied by xmmword_5D8A50) into v9, producing four cubic weight polynomials evaluated at t.
Load the end control pair from a7 (high half of an XMM register, two floats) and scale it by broadcast weights taken from v9 lanes 2,3 (shuffle 250) into v10.
Load the start control pair from a5, scale it by broadcast weights taken from v9 lanes 0,1 (shuffle 80), and add v10 into v11.
Sum v11 with its high-half moved to low lanes (movehl) and store the low two floats to the output pointer a3: out[0] = a5[0]*w0 + a7[0]*w2, out[1] = a5[1]*w1 + a7[1]*w3.

clean_pseudocode: // a8 = parameter t; a5/a7 = start/end control pairs; result = a3 (2 floats)
w = t * XMM[0x005D8A80] + XMM[0x005D8A60] + t2 * XMM[0x005D8A70] + t3 * XMM[0x005D8A50]; // 4 lanes
